reason: System lines the generated NPC conversations show when an action fails (inventory full, quest cannot be accepted or completed) and around a transport route (level and fare checks, the unfinished-quest list, the Yes/No to board). MeowDB publishes no client system messages and no boarding dialogue, so this text is MisoStory's own wording, shown with speaker "system" (not as NPC speech). {name} placeholders are filled from the canonical route (destination, fare, min_level), the departure boundary (region) or, for {quests}, the character's quest log at the time the line is shown.

inventory_full.text: Your inventory is full. Make room in the right inventory tab, then talk again.
inventory_full.reason: Shown when Inventory.can_add_all refuses quest accept items, quest rewards or a re-issued quest item.

cannot_accept.text: You cannot accept this quest right now.
cannot_accept.reason: Shown when an accept action is refused for a reason other than a full inventory.

cannot_complete.text: You cannot complete this quest right now.
cannot_complete.reason: Shown when a completion is refused for a reason other than a full inventory or a wrong quiz answer.

transport_level_too_low.text: You need to be at least level {min_level} to sail to {destination}.
transport_level_too_low.reason: Shown when the character is below the route's canonical min_level (Shanks: level 7, from the MeowDB beginner guide). MeowDB has no refusal line for Shanks.

transport_not_enough_mesos.text: The fare to {destination} is {fare} mesos. Come back when you have enough.
transport_not_enough_mesos.reason: Shown when the character holds fewer mesos than the route's canonical fare_mesos (Shanks: 300). MeowDB has no refusal line for Shanks.

departure_unfinished_quests.reason: Follows the beginner guide's canonical advice ("Hand in every Maple Island quest before you board.", shown on the page before) with the character's own unfinished quests, chains grouped. A warning only: boarding is still offered.

transport_offer.text: Sail to {destination}? The fare is {fare} mesos.
transport_offer.reason: The Yes/No to board, with the canonical destination and fare. MeowDB has no boarding prompt for Shanks (gap in game/data/canonical/npcs/15.json).

cannot_travel.reason: Shown when boarding is refused for a reason other than level or fare (e.g. a route without a departure boundary: travel past Maple Island is not built).

offer_prompt.reason: Generic MisoStory system framing, not NPC speech. A quest whose MeowDB record has no "On accept" dialogue (Maple Island: only 1002 Roger's Apple) is offered as a quest card (speaker "journal": the quest title, the canonical journal summary, the NPC's portrait). The summary is a description ("Talk to Roger."), not a question, so the card adds this line under it as the Yes/No prompt. It names no NPC, item or quest, so it never invents dialogue.

misostory_hint_controls.text: [MisoStory] Here you talk to someone by walking up to them and pressing F; a mouse click attacks. W, A, S and D walk, and Space or Alt jumps.
misostory_hint_controls.reason: Heena's canonical tutorial lines (quest 1000 On accept, lines 0 and 1) teach classic MapleStory's controls: click a person to talk, the left and right arrows to move. Under MisoStory's controls (game/scripts/autoload/controls.gd BINDINGS: interact F, attack J / Ctrl / left mouse, move W A S D, jump Space / Alt; the arrows enter portals and climb) a click swings the weapon and the arrows do not walk. The canonical lines stay as they are; this system page follows them (misostory/dialogue/1.json), marked [MisoStory] so it is never read as Heena's speech. Its key names must follow controls.gd.

misostory_hint_chairs.text: [MisoStory] Press X to sit on a chair you own, such as The Green Relaxer from Pio. Maple Island has no benches or map seats to sit on.
misostory_hint_chairs.reason: Rain's canonical quiz 4 lines (quest 1016: the wrong-answer line for 'Sit on a chair' and the right-answer tip) tell the player to press the sit key near a chair or bench around the map. MisoStory has no map seats (recovery.json sitting: no ground sit, no benches, a source gap) and the sit key (X, controls.gd) sits on the first chair the character owns (contract C5); The Green Relaxer is Pio's reward (quest 1012). The canonical lines stay as they are; this system page follows each of them (misostory/dialogue/19.json), marked [MisoStory].
